contentShape: A Puck document is { root: { props: {} }, content: [ Block ] }. A Block is { type: "<block type>", props: { id: "<unique>", ...fields } }. Nest children by putting an array of Blocks in a slot prop (see each block's "slots"). Every block also accepts the shared "styleProps". Leave "id" out and the API fills it in. A block's "module" names the module that provides it (null = core); a module block only renders while that module is enabled, so prefer core blocks unless the site uses that module.
